directions.text: Flat bone protecting heart and great vessels. Manubrium, body, and xiphoid process. Contains blood-forming marrow. Selected sternal marrow sampling uses aspiration; core biopsy is usually taken from the iliac crest.
Protects the brain. The skull has 8 cranial bones (frontal, parietal×2, temporal×2, occipital, sphenoid, ethmoid) and 14 facial bones (22 in total).

screenshots.name: phone-arabic-contrast-feedback-direction.png
screenshots.observation: Contrast feedback preserves Arabic hierarchy and left-to-right English functions; named answer/correct states and Next remain legible with no horizontal clipping.

screenshots.name: phone-arabic-dark-feedback-direction.png
screenshots.observation: Dark larger-text feedback retains Arabic heading direction and clear colors; both English functions now have normal sentence and parenthesis order without leading punctuation.

screenshots.name: phone-arabic-dark-study-direction.png
screenshots.observation: Study banner and Arabic return remain right to left above the full 2D skeleton; direction refinement has no visible effect on the study context or diagram controls.

screenshots.name: phone-arabic-light-feedback-direction.png
screenshots.observation: Arabic headings and controls read right to left; each English function paragraph reads left to right with final punctuation following its sentence. Phone wrapping is clear.

findings: Both authored English function paragraphs use their own left-to-right reading direction; sentence periods and parentheses stay in the English reading order.
Arabic headings, instructions, answer labels and study-return context retain right-to-left direction.
All three themes at 320px and larger text are readable without clipped content; the full dark study model retains its layout.

scope: Arabic larger text at 320px across light, dark and contrast themes; only the two authored function paragraphs gained dir=auto. The complete five-journey/twenty-scan 076c checkpoint remains separate.
